[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Alexandr Wang megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Legora (@WeAreLegora); megjelent: 2026-11-19T16:56:16+00:00; link: https://x.com/WeAreLegora/status/2123460359017144769; média: videó, 31 másodperc]
The November BAR results are now available, showing how AI models compare on real-world legal tasks in Legora.

A few highlights from this month’s results:

→ Muse Wonder ranks highest on overall quality and leads across four task types: analysis and answering, extraction, drafting, and editing.

→ GPT-6.2 Astra leads on comparison and review tasks, with overall quality 4% above November’s model average and cost per case 20% below average.

→ GPT-6.2 Sol delivers above-average quality at 78% below the average cost per case across models benchmarked in November.
